results.label: scam
results.text: USPS: Your package could not be delivered due to an unpaid customs fee of $1.99. Pay within 12 hours or it will be returned: http://usps-redelivery-help.top/pay
results.summary: This is a fake USPS delivery text sending you to a non-official payment site to steal your money and card details.

results.label: scam
results.text: FedEx: We attempted delivery but nobody was home. Confirm your address and reschedule here: fedex-reschedule-now.info/track?id=88213
results.summary: This is a fake FedEx delivery message — the link goes to fedex-reschedule-now.info, not the real fedex.com, to steal your address and payment information.

results.label: scam
results.text: DHL Express: your parcel is held at our depot. A customs charge of $2.45 is required. Pay at dhl-customs-pay.xyz to release it.
results.summary: This is a DHL impersonation scam — the payment link is not on DHL's real dhl.com domain and DHL never requests customs fees this way.

results.label: scam
results.text: NJ E-ZPass: You have an unpaid toll balance of $12.50. To avoid a $50 late fee, pay by today: ezpass-nj-tollpay.top/inv
results.summary: This is a fake NJ E-ZPass text trying to get you to pay on a look-alike website (ezpass-nj-tollpay.top) that is not the real E-ZPass site.

results.label: scam
results.text: Chase Alert: Unusual $849.00 charge on your card. If this was not you, verify now or your account will be locked: chase-secure-verify.top/login
results.summary: This is a fake Chase alert trying to get you to click a copycat website to steal your login — Chase only uses chase.com and would not lock your account from a text link like this.

results.label: scam
results.text: Wells Fargo: Your account has been temporarily restricted. Call our fraud department at 1-855-555-0113 immediately to restore access.
results.summary: This claims to be Wells Fargo about a restricted account and urges you to call an unverified number — don't call the number in the text; check your account directly via the official app or card.

results.label: scam
results.text: Bank of America: we detected a login from a new device. To cancel, reply with the 6-digit code we just sent you.
results.summary: This is a scam impersonating Bank of America to steal your login code — real banks never ask you to share a 6-digit one-time code.

results.label: scam
results.text: Zelle: A payment of $500 to you is pending because your account is not upgraded. Send $100 to unlock it, you will be refunded instantly.
results.summary: This is an advance-fee scam impersonating Zelle — you are asked to send $100 to “unlock” a fake $500 payment with a false instant-refund promise.

results.label: scam
results.text: Venmo: you were sent $350 by mistake. Please return it via this link right away or your account will be suspended: venmo-refund-help.click/r
results.summary: This is a Venmo impersonation scam using a fake refund demand and threat of suspension to get you to click a non-official link.

results.label: scam
results.text: PayPal invoice #INV-44821 for $479.99 (Norton antivirus renewal) has been paid. If you did not authorize this, call 1-888-555-0177 within 24 hours to cancel.
results.summary: Fake PayPal/Norton invoice designed to trick you into calling 1-888-555-0177 — no real charge, do not call.

results.label: scam
results.text: Amazon: Your order of an iPhone 15 Pro for $1,149 has been placed. If you did not make this purchase call 1-877-555-0166 to cancel.
results.summary: This is a fake Amazon order alert that tries to get you to call a scammer-run phone number to 'cancel'.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi, this is Mark from the Amazon billing team. Your account has a security hold. To clear it purchase two $500 Amazon gift cards and read me the codes.
results.summary: This is an Amazon billing impersonation scam asking you to pay a fake 'security hold' with $1,000 in Amazon gift cards.

results.label: scam
results.text: IRS FINAL NOTICE: You owe $2,847 in back taxes. A warrant will be issued for your arrest today. Call 855-555-0142 immediately and pay with Apple gift cards. Do not tell anyone.
results.summary: This is an IRS impersonation scam demanding Apple gift cards under threat of arrest.

results.label: scam
results.text: This is the Social Security Administration. Your social security number has been suspended due to suspicious activity. Call 855-555-0150 or a warrant will be issued for your arrest.
results.summary: This is a fake SSA arrest-threat scam trying to scare you into calling the scammers.

results.label: scam
results.text: Medicare: you are eligible for a new 2026 benefits card with $1,200 in grocery allowance. Reply YES and confirm your Medicare number to receive it.
results.summary: Fake Medicare text promising a $1,200 grocery allowance card to trick you into sharing your Medicare number.

results.label: scam
results.text: Apple ID: Your iCloud account is locked due to suspicious activity. Verify within 24h or all photos will be deleted: apple-id-unlock.support/verify
results.summary: This is a scam text pretending to be Apple to steal your Apple ID — do not click the link.

results.label: scam
results.text: WARNING: Your computer is infected with 5 viruses! Do not turn off your PC. Call Microsoft Support now at 1-800-555-0123.
results.summary: This is a fake Microsoft tech-support scare - Microsoft does not send virus warnings with a phone number to call.

results.label: scam
results.text: Geek Squad: your 3-year protection plan renews today for $389.99. To cancel and get a refund call 1-866-555-0188.
results.summary: This is a fake Geek Squad renewal invoice trying to get you to call a scam number for a refund.

results.label: scam
results.text: Netflix: your payment failed and your account will be closed. Update billing now: netflix-billing-update.top/account
results.summary: This is a fake Netflix billing alert trying to get you to enter payment details on a look-alike site — the link is not Netflix.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi Sarah, are we still on for dinner Friday? Let me know!
results.summary: This looks like a classic 'wrong number' opener - a friendly message to Sarah about dinner that invites a reply but you have no context for who it is.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hello, I got your number from a friend. I'm Emily, I just moved to the city and don't know anyone. Can we chat? 😊
results.summary: This is an unsolicited friendly introduction from a stranger asking you to start chatting, which is a common first step for later relationship or investment scams.

results.label: scam
results.text: I've been making $3,000 a week with a crypto trading platform my uncle taught me. I can show you how, small deposit of $250 to start, guaranteed returns. Message me on WhatsApp.
results.summary: This is a classic crypto investment scam promising impossible guaranteed weekly returns for a small upfront deposit and pushing you to WhatsApp.

results.label: scam
results.text: My dear, I am a US Army engineer deployed overseas. I have fallen in love with you. I need $800 in iTunes cards to take leave and come meet you.
results.summary: This is a classic military romance scam — a real U.S. Army soldier would never need iTunes gift cards to take leave and meet you.

results.label: scam
results.text: Grandma it's me, I'm in jail and I need bail money, please don't tell mom and dad. Can you send $2,400 in Google Play cards? A lawyer will call you.
results.summary: This is the classic "grandparent bail" scam — impersonating a grandchild in jail to pressure you into buying Google Play gift cards and keeping it secret.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi! We found your resume. Remote job, earn $200-$400 per day liking videos. No experience needed. Contact our manager on Telegram @workfromhome_jobs to start today.
results.summary: This is a classic fake 'liking videos' task/job scam — high pay for simple clicks and asking you to move to Telegram to start.

results.label: scam
results.text: Congratulations on the personal assistant job! Enclosed is a check for $3,800. Deposit it and send $1,500 via Zelle to our equipment vendor, keep the rest as your pay.
results.summary: This is a classic fake-check job scam — no real employer sends you a check and tells you to forward part of it via Zelle.

results.label: scam
results.text: CONGRATULATIONS! You've won $750,000 in the Mega Millions International Lottery. To claim, send a $199 processing fee. Reply with your full name and bank details.
results.summary: You didn't enter this lottery and real lotteries never require an upfront fee or bank details by text to claim a prize — this is an advance-fee lottery scam.

results.label: scam
results.text: Coinbase: a withdrawal of 0.8 BTC is pending. If this was not you, secure your wallet immediately by entering your 12-word recovery phrase: coinbase-secure-wallet.info
results.summary: This is a fake Coinbase message trying to steal your 12-word recovery phrase — that phrase gives full control of your crypto wallet and Coinbase will never ask for it.

results.label: scam
results.text: You are eligible for a tax refund of $1,462.18. Submit your request and bank details here to receive the payment: gov-taxrefund-claim.top
results.summary: This is a fake IRS/government tax refund message using a non-government website to steal your bank details.

results.label: scam
results.text: Duke Energy: your power will be disconnected in 1 hour due to an overdue balance of $312. Pay now using a Bitcoin ATM, call 1-800-555-0102 for instructions.
results.summary: The investigation could not finish (step limit reached), so treat this message with caution.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi, are you at your desk? I need you to buy 5 Target gift cards for a client gift, $200 each. I'm in a meeting so can't talk. I'll reimburse you today. Send me the codes. - Jim, CEO
results.summary: This is a classic CEO impersonation gift-card scam asking you to buy $1,000 in Target gift cards and send the codes.

results.label: scam
results.text: State DMV: you have an outstanding traffic violation. Failure to pay $58 within 48 hours will result in license suspension: dmv-state-pay.xyz/citation
results.summary: This is a fake DMV text trying to scare you into paying at a non-government link that doesn't even resolve to a real website.

results.label: scam
results.text: You qualify for federal student loan forgiveness of up to $20,000. This offer ends tonight. Reply with your FSA ID and SSN to apply.
results.summary: This is a government-impersonation scam: the real Federal Student Aid never asks you to text back your FSA ID and SSN to claim forgiveness.

results.label: scam
results.text: Instagram: your account will be permanently disabled for copyright violation. Appeal within 12 hours: instagram-appeal-center.click/case
results.summary: This is a fake Instagram copyright threat trying to get you to click an imitation link — the link is not on Instagram's real domain and the urgent ban threat is a common phishing trick.

results.label: scam
results.text: Hello, this is the fraud prevention department of Amazon. We have detected suspicious activity on your account and ordered a $1,299 item. Press 1 to speak with an agent to cancel this order.
results.summary: This is a fake Amazon fraud robocall impersonating Amazon to get you to press 1 and speak to a scammer — Amazon says to check Your Orders in the official app, not by pressing buttons on calls.

results.label: scam
results.text: Subject: Please review and sign: Payroll_Update_Q4.pdf. You have a new secure document. Sign here to view: docusign-secure-review.top/doc/8812
results.summary: This is a fake DocuSign link for a payroll document — the address is not DocuSign's real website and is designed to steal your login or information.

results.label: scam
results.text: Microsoft 365: your password expires today. Keep your current password by confirming here: o365-password-keep.info/login

results.label: scam
results.text: Hi, I'm interested in your apartment listing. I'm out of the country so can't view it, but I can send a deposit via Zelle if you hold it for me. Please send your bank details.
